name: Crimp Goblin
tagline: If it fits three fingers, it's a jug.
flavorText: You don't necessarily need better beta. You need stronger fingers and questionable decision-making. Tiny edges call to you like nothing else, and you will happily turn your fingertips into sandpaper chasing them.
villainLine: They don't understand why you're pulling so hard on a hold with no edge at all.
partnerLine: You bring the finger strength, they bring the friction — between you, nothing on the wall is safe.
